Claim amendment 1 on #30206 · 2026-11-05T14:18Z

The dev's check of 「中国」 in 默认国家 found the refusal starts in the console. `SettingsField.tsx`'s `DomainCombobox` swaps typed text for the option's code only when the text equals the option label (「中国 (CN)」 in the zh pack) or the code, so 「中国」 is submitted as typed. The server then refuses it with `invalid_format` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts`, pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2}$`), whose message is not localized.

File surface grows by the console half: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` (a typed country name resolves to its code) and the settings view that renders field errors (a refusal with code `invalid_format` is drawn from the console's own localized text), with their tests. ⛔ `packages/**` stays out: the server's pattern check is correct as it is, and the console reading the error by code is what localizes it, so no server card is filed for this item.

PR #30552 (head `9914c31f`) touches files outside the claimed surface. Each one reads the removed dialog, so the seat takes them into the surface:

- `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx`, `loadLocales.ts` (comment), `pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx` (import) and four console test mocks that named `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt`.

- Three i18n count tests (`machineLocaleCensus-9909`, `console-copy-system-noun-12956`, `de-quote-pairing-3876`) that count keys this PR adds or retires.

Seat calls on the dev's two questions:

- **Placement:** Home only. The card allows the home page or the top of Setup; one place keeps one dismissal and one reading of the rows.
- **Declaration:** the PR retires the `console.workspaceTimezonePrompt.*` keys from the ten published packs of `@object-ui/i18n`. By the lane's precedent for retired keys (PR #29359 `yes (narrowing)`, PR #29616 `no (narrowing)`, both with `!`), the arm is `(narrowing)`: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `!` in the title and the changeset summary, and the full dogfood battery on the final head. `Metadata-protocol: none` stands. The review face becomes CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER.
